protocol.hypothesis: A completed price/flow reversal after funding and OI crowding identifies a cost-adjusted reversal more efficiently than the same price-only control.
protocol.market: Actual Binance USD-M linear perpetual contracts, bounded two-major-contract research; no whole-exchange survivor-free claim
protocol.cadence: Complete UTC four-hour OHLCV formed from exactly four consecutive original one-hour trade bars; observe at completed boundary plus10minutes; execute no earlier than next four-hour boundary. No retroactive close/open fills.
protocol.availability: Every OI, funding and structure input requires independently evidenced historical available_ms; event_ms<=signal boundary and available_ms<=observation. CSV create_time, present collection time and object LastModified are never substituted for historical availability. Unknown evidence fails closed.
protocol.OI: Latest OI at or before signal boundary and latest at or before boundary minus24h; each at most15minutes stale; both positive, timestamped and verified available. Current OI / prior OI -1 >=0.05.
protocol.funding: Arithmetic mean of latest3 actually settled funding rates, all events strictly before signal boundary, latest not older than24h. Do not infer a predicted funding rate or assume an eight-hour charging interval.
long_all: completed close exceeds its open and previous close
completed taker-buy quote volume / total quote volume >=0.55
short_all: completed close below its open and previous close
completed taker-buy quote volume / total quote volume <=0.45
protocol.ranking: Absolute mean funding descending, symbol ascending; maximum one position per contract, no adds
protocol.initial_stop: Signal close minus/plus2.5 arithmetic ATR14 of complete4h bars; distance between1% and8%; re-size using actual delayed simulated execution and all costs
protocol.exit: Stop first at adverse trade open on gaps; half at3 original R; delayed4h trailing six-bar low/high minus/plus0.25 ATR14; exit after18four-hour bars or mean settled funding crosses0 against the crowding premise
protocol.risk_enforcement: A future engine must reduce drift above aggregate risk/gross caps at the next observable tradable one-hour quote, record intrahour gap uncertainty, and never claim a guaranteed loss ceiling. Cash collateral cannot be reused as borrowed purchasing power.
protocol.funding_cost: Signed quantity times actual settlement mark times realized rate at every actual settlement timestamp; positive funding debits longs and credits shorts. Exact original timestamps including milliseconds are retained. Missing settlement marks are not silently replaced by hourly prices or zero expense.
protocol.futures_terms_gate: Historical contract identity, listing/termination, price/quantity filters and maintenance-margin/settlement terms must be sufficient for the tested cash-collateral scope. Present exchangeInfo is not historical terms.
protocol.controls_if_data_gate_passes: Same price/flow reversal control without funding/OI/basis filters plus200 same-time randomized-selection stress accounts, seeds0..199; identical collateral, costs, funding, exits and risk. No controls run on unqualified data.
protocol.decision: NEEDS_MORE_EVIDENCE if mandatory availability/terms/settlement evidence is missing; do not manufacture a flat zero-return curve. REJECT only for measured performance failures on qualified data. PASS requires all data, execution, independent reproduction, sample and profitability gates; then separate90-day no-order forward evidence remains necessary.
protocol.implementation_scope_this_pr: Source audit, independent byte/row reproduction, strict as-of signal evaluator and cost arithmetic. Full futures account/execution engine and performance controls remain deferred when the mandatory data gate fails.

source: Official archives only, data qualification before any strategy PnL
